title: BPaLM and BPaL
dek: Six months of bedaquiline, pretomanid, linezolid 600 mg, plus moxifloxacin if FQ-S. WHO’s preferred RR/MDR regimen when eligible. FQ-R drops the M. Pregnancy drops the Pa.
story: WHO suggests 6-month BPaLM (bedaquiline, pretomanid, linezolid 600 mg daily, moxifloxacin) rather than 9-month or longer regimens for eligible MDR/RR-TB. If fluoroquinolone resistance is confirmed, drop moxifloxacin and continue BPaL; BPaL may extend toward 9 months when response is slow. CDC/IDSA 2025 overlay: BPaLM for ≥14 years with RR, FQ-S pulmonary disease; BPaL when FQ-R or FQ-intolerant.

Eligibility gates: typically age ≥14 (programme-dependent), no pretomanid in pregnancy/breastfeeding (limited safety), caution in TBM and some extra-pulmonary sites, and do not start if BDQ/LZD/Pa resistance is known. Linezolid is 600 mg daily in the 2022–2025 WHO text — not the 1200 mg Nix-TB opening dose as a routine.

Unknown FQ DST should not delay BPaLM: start with the M, then drop it if gyrA/QRDR says FQ-R. If BDQ, LZD, or Pa is compromised, leave this acronym and go to BDLLfxC, a 9-month oral regimen, or an individualised longer regimen.
deep: Linezolid: myelosuppression, neuropathy; some programmes TDM trough <2 µg/mL. Neuropathy is why people stop LZD and then fail.
Bedaquiline: QTc, hepatic; CYP3A4 (rifamycins are the enemy; you already left rifampin).
Pretomanid: hepatotoxicity, lactic acidosis rare, testicular toxicity in animals — hence the pregnancy caution.
Week 8–16 cultures still matter. A 6-month calendar is not a substitute for knowing whether the sputum converted.

visual.caption: RR-TB eligible for a 6-month all-oral: start BPaLM, drop M if FQ-R, leave the acronym if BDQ/LZD/Pa is lost or pregnancy forbids pretomanid.

example.title: Pregnant RR-TB, FQ unknown
example.setup: 28-year-old, 22 weeks pregnant, Xpert RIF detected, FQ DST pending. Ward wants BPaLM today.

steps.title: Pretomanid gate
steps.body: WHO: BPaLM recommendation does not apply to pregnant/breastfeeding people because Pa safety is insufficient.

steps.title: 2025 alternative
steps.body: BDLLfxC (or a 9-month oral such as BLMZ) is the designed off-ramp. Start a complete regimen, then drop Lfx or CFZ per FQ result as the BDLLfxC SOP says.

steps.title: Do not wait idle
steps.body: Pregnancy is not a reason to give two weak drugs for a month. It is a reason to pick the non-Pa 6- or 9-month construct.

example.takeaway: BPaLM is preferred when eligible — eligibility includes not being pregnant on pretomanid.

check.why: D94G is FQ-R. The M is not a decoration you keep for the acronym.
